news.title: Socceroos still waiting for World Cup payment from FA
news.lede: Socceroos players are awaiting payment from this year's FIFA World Cup. (Reuters: Kai Pfaffenbach). Players from the Socceroos who participated in this year's FIFA World Cup are yet to be paid their fees. Payment was supposed to be made within a fortnight of the team leaving camp, following their round-of-32 loss to Egypt.

news.title: Man United make contact with World Cup-winning manager but face unexpected setback – report
news.lede: Manchester United have made contact with former France manager Didier Deschamps as the club continues to explore managerial options amid growing uncertainty surrounding Michael Carrick’s future. That is according to a report from French outlet Foot Mercato, which claims that Manchester United board leaders have reached out to Deschamps in recent days to see if he is interested in taking over at Old Trafford. The Red Devils’ hierarchy is actively sounding out elite profiles to stabilise the club during a chaotic Premier League campaign. The report adds that while United have also made approaches to Germany boss Julian Nagelsmann and Aston Villa’s Unai Emery, who appears set to sign an extension with the club, Deschamps has emerged as a big name target.

news.title: Shock twist to World Cup captain Ryan Mendes’s NZ rape claim as woman charged with making a false statement
news.lede: New Zealand police have charged a woman following a sexual assault investigation into Cape Verde’s World Cup captain Ryan Mendes. Allegations against Mendes resurfaced during the World Cup earlier this year as he guided the tiny African country to the Round of 32. He had not been charged at the time, and will not face any after the investigation wrapped up this week. “Detective Inspector Scott Beard says the allegation has not been substantiated,” NZ Police said in a statement.

news.title: Europe's top international scorers: Cristiano Ronaldo out in front, ahead of Romelu Lukaku, Robert Lewandowski and Harry Kane
news.lede: Cristiano Ronaldo scored a staggering 146 international goals for Portugal. Who else is among the leading goalscorers? Cristiano Ronaldo retires from duty for Portugal having become the first European to reach 100 international goals in autumn 2020 – and remains well out in front as both Europe's and the world's all-time leading scorer. He marked his 200th Portugal appearance with an 89th-minute winner in Iceland on 20 June 2023 before rubber-stamping his side's place at UEFA EURO 2024 with two goals against Slovakia on 13 October 2023.

news.title: SAFA Chief Medical Officer Dr Ngwenya heading to the FIFA U-17 World Cup Qatar 2026
news.lede: 5 November 2026 – Fresh after representing South Africa at the 2026 FIFA World Cup a few months ago, South African Football Association (SAFA) Chief Medical Officer Dr Thulani Ngwenya is on the move again. Dr Ngwenya is now heading to the FIFA U-17 World Cup Qatar 2026 where he will serve as Doping Control Officer. The tournament will take place from 19 November – 13 December 2026. “It is always a great honour and a privilege to be appointed to serve football at the highest level.
